in_marathi.name: Devamayi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods' Mother
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devamayi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi (Goddess) + Mayi (Mother of Gods). Derived from the Devi Mahatmya, a Hindu text that glorifies the goddess Durga. It is also a name for Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
